plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Web Developer A.S. Degree - CalGETC' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7999/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 62; verified = 16+15+16+15 = 62 (all semester headers match their rows). The Semester 3 row labeled 'Local Area 5B- Biological Sciences' carries GE AREA 'Cal-GETC Area 5B' (apparent row-label typo in a CalGETC map); encoded as Cal-GETC Area 5B. List A (minimum 5 units): CISC 324, CISW 308, CISW 310, CISW 355, CISW 402, CISP 350 — satisfied in-map by CISC 324 (1) + CISW 308 (2) + CISW 402 (2) = 5 units, each footnoted 'Suggested from List A'. CISP 350 prerequisite per map: CISA 320 & 3 units of any programming language. Area 3A suggestion: ART 301 Digital Drawing & Composition or ARTNM 324 Digital Design (advisory ART 300, 320, CISC 302, JOUR 330); both meet requirements for Certificate in CIS Web Programming and CIS Web Publishing. With the suggested electives, this map meets the requirements for the Certificate of Proficiency in CIS-Web Publishing and the Certificate of Achievement in CIS-Web Programming (no separate sequences published). Advisories (recommended, not required, per map legend): CISW 300 advisory CISC 305; CISW 440 advisory CISA 320 or CISP 350; CISP 353 advisory CISP 352; CISW 308 advisory CISW 304; CISW 402 advisory CISW 410; CISW 350 advisory CISC 306 & CISW 300; CISW 321 advisory CISC 305; CISW 410 advisory CISP 300 or CISW 310. CalGETC Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
